videos.script: Lesson 8 promised to show what the Responses API adds. Four things. {{shape}} First, a different shape: instructions and input go in, a list of typed items comes out. {{state}} Second, state. Send the id of the last response and OpenAI keeps the conversation for you. The instructions do not come with it. {{store}} Third, that state is stored, for thirty days at least, unless you say otherwise. That is a data question, and a delete call. {{limits}} And last, two promises: a request too long for the window fails instead of being cut, and a schema becomes a parsed object.
